title: Question about the ending
body: Can someone explain what happened to the detective in the final chapter? I'm confused about his decision.

answers.body: The detective chose to keep the secret to protect the town's reputation. It's a moral dilemma theme.

title: What does the alien language mean?
body: Does anyone know if the alien symbols in chapter 7 have actual meanings or are they just decorative?

answers.body: The author mentioned in an interview that they're based on mathematical concepts. Each symbol represents a prime number.
